events.text: The great bell of {sw_mine} rings at midnight and does not stop. By dawn the war roll is nailed to the hall door: the sect marches on {sw_foe}, and every disciple who can hold a blade is called to write a name under it.

choices.text: Write your name and take your place in the line

effects.log: You write your name in a steady hand. The steward hands you a strip of red cloth for your sleeve and a bowl of rice for the road.

choices.text: Write your name at the top: the front, or the raid party

effects.log: You write your name above all the others. The senior on duty looks at you for a long moment, then nods once.

choices.text: Leave the roll unsigned and keep to your room

effects.log: You hear the others go past your door all morning. You do not open it.

events.text: An elder you have only ever seen from the back of the hall stands at the gate of the outer courtyard. "{sw_foe} has crossed the border stones," the elder says. "The sect does not ask who is ready. It asks who will come."

choices.text: Step forward with the others

effects.log: You step forward into the ranks. Someone beside you is shaking, and you stand a little closer to them.

choices.text: Step forward alone and ask for the hardest post

effects.log: You ask for the front. The elder writes your name with a brush that does not hesitate, and the courtyard goes quiet.

choices.text: Stay where you are

effects.log: You stay where you are. The elder looks along the line, and the look stops on you for a breath longer than on anyone else.

events.text: A runner finds you with a letter sealed in the colours of {sw_mine}: war with {sw_foe}, every disciple to report to the muster ground within three days, and the name of each who does not will be read out in the hall.

choices.text: Pack a bag and report to the muster ground

effects.log: You report on the second day, and the quartermaster gives you a blade that has been sharpened by someone who cared.

choices.text: Report at once and volunteer for the raid party

effects.log: You report before the ink of your letter is dry. The raid captain takes your name and says only, "We leave at night."

choices.text: Burn the letter and stay where you are

effects.log: The letter curls in the brazier. Three days later your name is read out in the hall, and you are not there to hear it.

events.text: The banners of {sw_mine} go up on every wall, and the drill ground fills before sunrise. A senior with a list walks the rows of the disciples' quarters, knocking on each door: war with {sw_foe}, and the list is not yet long enough.

choices.text: Open the door and give your name

effects.log: You give your name. The senior writes it down and moves to the next door, and it is done.

choices.text: Give your name, and ask to go where it is worst

effects.log: The senior stops writing. "Where it is worst," the senior repeats, and underlines your name twice.

choices.text: Do not answer the knock

effects.log: The knocking stops after a while. The senior writes something next to your door number anyway.

events.text: Your column holds a river ford against {sw_foe}. At first light their fighters wade in, and one of them comes straight for the gap beside you.

choices.text: Meet the one coming for the gap

ok.log: You meet them in the shallows and drive them back across the water. The gap stays closed.

fail.log: They are faster than you in the water. You go down in the shallows, and the disciple beside you drags you out.

choices.text: Hold your place in the line and let the line fight

effects.log: You lock shields with the others and do not move. The water decides what it decides.

events.text: You stand on a wall of an outpost of {sw_mine}. Ladders come up out of the dark, and the first head over the top is a fighter of {sw_foe} with a sabre in the teeth.

choices.text: Fight them on the wall

ok.log: You meet them at the top of the ladder, and the ladder goes back down without them.

fail.log: They get over the wall before you can stop them, and you take a blow meant for the gate guard.

choices.text: Keep to your post and pass the stones

effects.log: You pass stones hand to hand until your arms shake. Whatever happens on the wall happens to all of you together.

events.text: You guard a supply train of {sw_mine} on a mountain road. In a narrow pass, fighters of {sw_foe} drop from the rocks above, and one of them lands in front of your cart.

choices.text: Fight the one in front of your cart

ok.log: You fight them over the rice sacks and win. The cart rolls on.

fail.log: They knock you off the cart, and you roll down the slope into the brush.

choices.text: Close up with the guards around the carts

effects.log: You close up with the others around the carts and wait for the officers to call the fight.

events.text: The raid party of {sw_mine} crosses into the lands of {sw_foe} at night to burn a granary. At the granary gate a champion of theirs is waiting, as if someone told them you were coming.

choices.text: Challenge the champion at the gate

ok.log: You win at the gate, and the granary burns behind you as the party runs for the hills.

fail.log: The champion is better than you. The party carries you out, and the granary does not burn.

choices.text: Hold the road while the others reach the granary

effects.log: You hold the road for the others in the dark, and wait to see who comes back along it.

events.text: You stand in the first rank of {sw_mine} as the two sides meet on an open field. Across the grass a champion of {sw_foe} steps out and points a spear at the first rank: at you.

choices.text: Step out and answer the challenge

ok.log: You step out before both sides and win. A roar goes up behind you that you will remember all your life.

fail.log: You step out and lose before both sides. They carry you back through the ranks.

choices.text: Keep the first rank together and charge with it

effects.log: You charge with the first rank, shoulder to shoulder, into whatever is waiting.

events.text: You lead three disciples of {sw_mine} into the camp of {sw_foe} to find their captain's tent. A guard with a champion's sash steps out of the shadows between the tents.

choices.text: Take the guard yourself

ok.log: You take the guard without a sound, and the tent beyond holds their marching orders.

fail.log: The guard is ready for you, and the camp wakes. You get out with a wound and nothing else.

choices.text: Pull back and hold the camp's edge for the others

effects.log: You fall back to the edge of the camp and hold the path open for the others, whatever they find.
